User: What is front_default?
Claude: front_default is a field in PokeAPI's JSON. Its value is the URL string of the Pokémon's default front-facing image. For Pikachu (/pokemon/25):
sprites: {
"front_default": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../pokemon/25.png"
"versions": {
"generation-vi": {
"omegaruby-alphasapphire": {
"front_default": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../generation-vi/omegaruby-alphasapphire/25.png"
"front_shiny": "..."
"back_default": "..."
The top-level sprites.front_default is the generic front sprite (front in pokemon.ts:59).
versions → generation-vi → omegaruby-alphasapphire → front_default is the front sprite from the Omega Ruby / Alpha Sapphire games (oras).
Sibling fields include back_default (back) and front_shiny (shiny).
Some Pokémon or versions don't have the image. The value is then null
column2: which is why the code uses ?? null.
